observations: Photo 0 shows a white PlayStation 5 console with the PS logo on the front, held in a hand.
Two controllers are visible: one white and black DualSense controller, and one black and white DualSense controller.
The console has a slim profile with a horizontal black line separating the top and bottom sections.
The controllers appear to be standard DualSense models, not FC26 (which is a different controller type).
The console is placed on a dark, marbled surface, possibly a countertop or floor.
There is a watermark 'POSTED SHOW GAMES' across the image.
No power cord, cables, or accessories are visible in the photo.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a PS5 Slim console, but there is no visible proof of origin (UK) or usage history. The 'UK' claim cannot be verified from the photo.
Photo 0 shows two DualSense controllers, not one pad and FC26. FC26 is a different controller type (not DualSense), and the photo shows only two DualSense controllers.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working. Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Console may be non-functional or have internal damage
risks.proof: A video showing the console powering on, booting up, and running a game.

risks.risk: Controllers may be non-functional or have dead buttons/ports
risks.proof: A video showing both controllers connecting to the console and responding to button presses.

risks.risk: Console may be stolen or have a blacklisted serial number
risks.proof: A photo of the console's serial number and a verification from PlayStation's official website.

risks.risk: Console may be missing accessories (power cable, HDMI cable, etc.)
risks.proof: A photo showing all included accessories laid out next to the console.

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and booting up.
Video of both controllers connecting and working with the console.
Photo of the console's serial number and a verification from PlayStation's website.
Photo of all included accessories (power cable, HDMI cable, etc.).
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
